text:
incident-bot: 🚨 INCIDENT 7955: Orpheus Systems (dedicated-us-west-2) — elevated 5xx errors observed for /v1/generate and /v1/embeddings since 03:24 UTC. Impact: ~30% of requests returning 500. Paging oncall: @maria (pagerduty) — please ack.

maria (oncall): Acked. Investigating root cause now — checking autoscaler, worker health.

ajay (sre): Looking into triton-worker-7 logs. I see repeated OOM and KV-cache growth. Autoscaler attempted scale but failed due to quota check. I'll try manual scale + restart.

leo (eng-runtime): Noted. If KV cache never evicts, we can hit OOM on long-tail requests. Plan: restart affected worker with cache-eviction patch AND enable per-account request routing to fallback model.

maria (oncall): Manual scale request sent to infra: +4 GPUs to pool. ETA ~4m. Applying routing override to send orpheus-system traffic to hosted-gen-2 as overflow.

incident-bot: Update: Scaling job submitted (job id: scale-7955-001). Routing override applied for account: orpheus-systems -> hosted-gen-2 (overflow).

jamie (cs): Drafting tailored customer blurb for Orpheus Systems — please review: 

"We are currently investigating increased error rates affecting generation and embedding requests for your dedicated deployment in us-west-2. Some requests may return 500 errors or time out. Our engineers are actively scaling capacity and enabling a fallback route to our hosted model to reduce failures. We expect visible mitigation within 10 minutes and will follow up with a full incident summary and timeline."

sophia (acct-mgr): Add contact routing for outbound notify. Who at Orpheus to cc? Also confirm whether to include legal.

jamie (cs): Proposed contact list for outbound (include in notify):
```
- Claire Nguyen (SRE lead) <claire@orpheus.com>
- Ravi Patel (Platform) <ravi@orpheus.com>
- support@orpheus.com (support alias)
- ops@orpheus.com (ops)
- Optional: legal@orpheus.com if they request contract impact
```

sophia (acct-mgr): ok will include Claire + Ravi + support alias. I'll loop in legal if they escalate.

ajay (sre): Mitigation progress: manual scale completed, +4 GPUs provisioned. Restarted triton-worker-7 with cache eviction toggle. Error rate decreased from ~30% -> ~5% in the last 2m. Keeping fallback routing active for at least 15m to stabilize.

incident-bot: Update: Incident severity set to SEV2 — mitigations in progress. Next automated update in 5m.

leo (eng-runtime): Recommend follow-ups for post-incident: 
- Adjust autoscaler quota checks so reserved-capacity tenants can bypass soft quota in emergency.
- Add KV cache eviction guard for long-running sequences.
- Add a canary for per-account KV growth.

maria (oncall): Current metrics: error rate 0.8% over last 1m, p95 latency unchanged. Monitoring for 30m before clear.

jamie (cs): Final outbound customer note (to send once <1% errors): 
"Hi Claire — we've deployed emergency capacity and enabled a fallback routing to reduce failed requests. Error rates have dropped and traffic is stable; we're monitoring for 30 minutes and will share a detailed post-incident summary. Apologies for the disruption — we're prioritizing a permanent fix to prevent recurrence."

sophia (acct-mgr): I'll send the note to Claire + Ravi + support@orpheus.com in 5m unless we see regression.

incident-bot: Incident 7955 updated: mitigations applied, monitoring. If stable for 30m, incident will be moved to RESOLVED.

leo (eng-runtime): Filing ticket for autoscaler change + KV eviction PR. Tagging eng-runtime and eng-ml.

maria (oncall): Thanks all — leaving monitoring to infra team for the next 30m. Will hand off oncall at 04:00 UTC if stable.

jamie (cs): After-action: I'll draft customer-facing incident summary and internal postmortem template (impact, timeline, root cause, remediation plan).

sophia (acct-mgr): Copy — will set follow-up call with Orpheus for tomorrow to review impact and next steps.

incident-bot: Thread archived for follow-up items. Remember to attach graphs (error rate, p95 latency, worker CPU/mem) to the postmortem. :thumbsup:
